name: tasktrack
description: TaskTrack provides durable human decisions and AI-maintained project dashboards through one MCP service. Use human TaskTrack only for evidence a person must supply; use dashboard tools for visual project state, milestones, progress, next actions, risks, verification and revision history.

interface.shortDescription: One MCP for durable human decisions and visual project state.
interface.longDescription: Register TaskTrackMcp.exe once. Its human-decision tools collect durable human evidence through TaskTrackGui.exe, while its dashboard tools maintain and open TaskTrackDashboardGui.exe. The authority domains remain separate: agent-authored dashboard state never becomes human answer evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use TaskTrack for the next human decision that machine evidence cannot resolve.
Ask me for a Pass/Fail verification through TaskTrack.
Update the TaskTrack dashboard with the current project state.
Open the project dashboard so I can review milestones, progress and risks.
